question.text: The EV/EBITDA multiple is most useful for valuing companies that are:

answer.text: Highly capital intensive and not yet making book profits at PAT level
Service sector companies with minimal tangible assets

explanation.text: The Logic: EV/EBITDA is extremely useful for highly capital-intensive firms that may not be profitable at PAT or even EBIT level (due to high depreciation/amortization), but are generating positive cash flows at the EBITDA level for all fund providers. The Trap: Loss-making startups with no revenue cannot use EV/EBITDA either — this metric needs positive EBITDA.
